newsitem.title: USA: Simpson denies murdering ex-wife and friend.
newsitem.headline: Simpson denies murdering ex-wife and friend.

text.p: Testifying in court for the first time, O.J. Simpson on Friday again proclaimed his innocence, saying he did not murder his ex-wife and her friend.

At the end of Simpson's first day on the witness stand in his civil trial, the plaintiffs' lead attorney, Daniel Petrocelli, said: "You confronted Nicole Brown Simpson and you killed her, didn't you?"
"That is absolutely not true," Simpson said emphatically.
"And you killed Ronald Goldman, did you or did you not?" Petrocelli asked.
Simpson then denied Petrocelli's suggestion that he went back to his Brentwood estate, dropped one of the gloves he had been wearing and put his clothing in a bag.

Simpson was acquitted in October of last year of double murder charges, but he now faces a wrongful-death civil lawsuit brought by the victims' families. He is due to return to the witness stand on Monday and continue testifying on Tuesday as well.
